work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CXXXII at 73884 is followed by this act's displaced marginal summaries 73887-73897; the actual independent synopsis is 73900-73906, mechanically copied here instead of the catalog's marginal-title lead. Its addressee and Paul V selfprotocol follow at 73908-73914. The complete ordered paragraphs 1-8 recite earlier grants and reserve the patronage/presentation right, ending in dating 74117-74119/editorial dating 74121. Retain reading 73936 keyed to 73924, predecessor-source absence notes 73991-73992 and 73994-73996 keyed to 73949 and 73971, and reading 74106-74107 keyed to 74087. Those predecessor references do not replace the present act's body and are not separate acts. The previous act closes 73876-73881 and the next CXXXIII begins at 74124.
